statements.statement: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and exertional dyspnea
The patient has a known history of nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
The symptoms are clinically consistent with the patient's known history of nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
A 48-hour ambulatory electrocardiographic monitoring study (CPT 93226) is ordered
The study is ordered to correlate reported symptoms with any recorded cardiac arrhythmia
The study supports medical necessity under diagnosis I49.9
The diagnosis codes are I49.9 and I34.0
The service was denied under reason code PR-204
